answer: The pearl log keeps the sampled set and the penalty so the deterrent is verifiable. Because selection is random and the mesa seed is unrevealed until close, an attacker cannot dodge the sample, so colluding to grade clones' junk is a timber gamble with a negative expected value. A random sample of settled verdicts is re-graded by an independent panel each epoch, and a divergence found on re-check burns the original grader 9% of its standing plus a seat ban. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
